summary: The matrix has at most 100 cells and the trace at most 200 queries, which is too little legal scaling range for a stable runtime-class verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 3 <= n <= 10 and at most 2 * n^2 calls are made to adjacentSum and diagonalSum

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation performs at most eight boundary checks per cell during construction and one array access per query.
Regression checks every query value across affine permutation grids for every legal side length and deterministic random permutations against an independent coordinate oracle.
